toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: a comma separates the verbs of two clauses that meet ('vlieg' and 'het'), which also stops the learner misreading 'vlieg het' as one verb group.
toegepas.fout: The verbs of the relative clause and the main clause meet without a comma ('vlieg het'), so a reader can take them as one verb group.
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS puts a comma where the verbs of two clauses meet, and it stops a first-reading stumble without changing the meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'n Meganiese een' copies the English 'a mechanical one'; repeating the noun is the natural Afrikaans form (a different change from the restructure rejected earlier).
toegepas.fout: ''n Meganiese een' copies the English 'a mechanical one'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Repeating the noun is the natural written Afrikaans form, and it keeps the meaning and the sentence's structure.

toegepas.voor: is uit baie aparte vere gebou
toegepas.na: is uit baie aparte vere opgebou
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Opgebou uit' is the idiomatic way to say something is made up of many parts; 'gebou uit' reads as constructing a building.
toegepas.fout: 'Uit baie aparte vere gebou' uses the verb for building, which also echoes the lesson's 'deur mense gebou' for mechanical things.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Opgebou uit' is the fixed expression for 'made up of parts' and keeps the bird's wing apart from the built, mechanical one without moving the meaning.

laat_vaar.na: Aan die agterkant en by die punt
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A bare 'Agter' opening the sentence is terse and vague; 'aan die agterkant' says plainly that it is the back edge of the wing.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Agter' reads clearly against 'Die voorste rand' in the sentence before, so the longer phrase is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The subject is the colour, and colour does not 'have' spots or stripes; it forms them, which keeps the meaning and the 'kan'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Kleur kan kolle of strepe he' is acceptable, and the verb 'vorm' would sit two sentences after the art term 'vorm' (shape) in a lesson that teaches that term, which could confuse a reader.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: 'n Vlermuis is nie 'n voël nie maar 'n dier
laat_vaar_vorige.na: 'n Vlermuis is nie 'n voël nie, maar 'n dier
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A comma before 'maar' after the closing 'nie' marks the contrast and makes the sentence easier to read.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'maar 'n dier met vlerke van vel' has no verb of its own, so the AWS rule for a comma joining two sentences does not apply, and the double 'nie' already marks the contrast clearly.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: omdat mense hulle gebou het met dele wat soos 'n masjien saamwerk
laat_vaar_vorige.na: omdat mense hulle met dele gebou het wat soos 'n masjien saamwerk
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: In a subordinate clause the verb cluster normally goes after the prepositional phrase.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Putting the prepositional phrase after 'gebou het' is normal, natural Afrikaans and keeps 'dele' next to its relative clause; the proposal is only a different word order, and it matches the wording of the 'meganies' glossary entry less closely.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Sit 'n natuurlike vlerk langs 'n meganiese een.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Sit 'n natuurlike en 'n meganiese vlerk langs mekaar.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'n meganiese een' copies English 'a mechanical one'; Afrikaans does not use 'een' as a noun substitute this way.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Using 'een' as a noun substitute ('n meganiese een') is ordinary Afrikaans, so the proposal is a lateral rewording.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Jou eie werk en 'n maat se werk
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Kyk met dieselfde stappe na jou eie prent of model van iets wat vlieg.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Gebruik dieselfde stappe om na jou eie prent of model van iets wat vlieg te kyk.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: One does not look 'with' steps; using the steps to look reads more naturally and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original is clear to a Grade 5 reader, while the proposal is longer, puts a long object between 'na' and 'te kyk', breaks the parallel with 'Kyk net so na' in the next sentence and repeats 'Gebruik' from the paragraph's last sentence.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Jy kyk net na hoe hulle lyk en nie na hoe hulle vlieg nie.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Jy kyk net na hoe hulle lyk, nie na hoe hulle vlieg nie.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The contrast reads more naturally without the joining 'en'; meaning unchanged.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original 'en nie na' is natural Afrikaans; replacing it with a comma is a lateral move.
